earned_by: E001 tested the clean-edge structure on five interacting algebras and was refuted only by A5's path-locality rule R4, which drew the neighbouring edge's private data at random, off that edge's own solution set. The clean-edge argument (COPRIME-PAIRS-20261027-001E, Lemmas 5-6) claims locality only on the joint solution variety. Post-hoc diagnostics (scoping/README.md, different seeds): for A5, with the neighbouring data on its single-edge solution set, e0's path sets equalled the single-edge sets in 36 of 36 comparisons, and off it they differed in 7 of 24; for A1, on the variety, the zero-jump design differed in 0 of 12 comparisons and the cumulative design in 12 of 12. This successor tests the on-variety claim on all five algebras with fresh seeds, and replicates E001's off-variety failure as a control.
question: For interacting pair failures satisfying the clean-edge conditions, on zero-jump gadgets at slope d/p: is the edge count F maximal on the diagonal and strictly smaller (but positive) across a pair-failing difference; do vertex-dual pairings vanish on every solution; and, on the path P3 with the neighbouring edge's data on its own solution set, are e0's solutions those of the single edge, with e1's equations and the vertex pairings vanishing on them?

public_inputs.algebras: free graded Lie algebras (cd_lib.free_graded): A1 class 3 on (1, 1) at d = 5, p = 11; A2 class 3 on (1, 2) at d = 5, p = 11; A3 class 4 on x (0), y (1) at d = 5, p = 11; A4 class 3 on (1, 2, 2) at d = 4, p = 5; A5 class 3 on (1, 2) at d = 4, p = 5
public_inputs.summands: pf_lib.summand_types: amphichiral 3-braids of gd.AMPH whose root characters are exactly {+-theta} at odd order (8_9 at +-1 and 4_1 at +-2 for p = 11, d = 5), (k,1)-cables of T(2,p) at even order 2k (root set R(theta))
public_inputs.gadget: pf_lib.build_gadget: zero-jump blocks (first and last strands exact copies of the base value; reading strand separated at every root character; dedicated stabilization copies), vertex blocks then per edge (d-1) unknot blocks + slot-1 block, (d-1) unknot blocks + slot-2 block; per edge one insertion of cable_d([A12, A23]) on bundles (d-1 copies of u, 1 copy of v), (d-1 base strands, slot-1 reading strand), (d-1 base strands, slot-2 reading strand); graphs K2 and the path 0-1-2
public_inputs.measurement: pf_lib.Gadget.evaluate on cd_lib.CyclicBraidModel at slope d/p: free data = coefficients of block class colourings below the top layer; equations = pairings <residual, J_t^T s> with block dual colourings, layer by layer; edge count F(sigma_u, sigma_v) = number of private configurations solving every private equation (exhaustive)

predictions.R1: F(sigma, sigma) = F_max = p^(private variables) for every sampled vertex state sigma, with every vertex-dual pairing zero
predictions.R2: 1 <= F(0, D) < F_max and 1 <= F(D, 0) < F_max for every sampled D in the theta_0 layer-1 component, vertex pairings zero
predictions.R3: every vertex-dual pairing vanishes on every solution for random vertex pairs
predictions.R4: on the path P3, with e1's private data pi_1 drawn from e1's single-edge solution set at (sigma_1, sigma_2): for each sampled sigma_0, the set of e0 private solutions on P3 equals the K2 solution set at (sigma_0, sigma_1); e1's private equations vanish on every e0 solution; every vertex-dual pairing vanishes on every e0 solution; e0 solutions exist
predictions.R5: hence F_max^4 - (F(0, D) F(D, 0))^2 > 0 for every sampled D (the edge matrix F F^T has rank at least two)

controls.machinery (any failure makes the run inv: M1 zero-jump blocks: base and end colour 0, reading strand nonzero, copies equal to it, at every root character; M2 insertions leave every cocycle space unchanged (dimension = 1 + number of blocks with a class); M3 on random data, all equations vanish exactly when every layer is solvable
controls.negative (a match makes the run invalid): X1: A1 on the cumulative design (reading strands = last strands) with the on-variety protocol of R4 -- some e0 path set must differ from its single-edge set; X2: A1 with the dual slot block of type +-1 (8_9) instead of +-2, so that no block carries duals at +-2 -- the edge count must equal F_max at (0, D) for every sampled D (no deficit); X3: A5 with e1's private data drawn outside its single-edge solution set (8 configurations, 3 sigma_0 each) -- some e0 path set must differ from its single-edge set, replicating E001's failure

decision_rule: Invalid if a machinery check fails or a negative control matches. Supported if R1-R5 hold for A1-A5. Refuted otherwise, naming every failed case; neither predictions nor construction change after this contract.
stop_rule: Run run.py once (after build_check.py); no adaptive extension.
seeds: numpy default_rng(20261028) in run.py (E001 used 20261027; the diagnostics used 11 and 5)
environment: workspace .venv python (numpy); cd_lib.py (COPRIME-DICHOTOMY-20261027-001A-P001), gd.py (COPRIME-DICHOTOMY-20261027-001B-E002), mlib.py (TRIPLE-SYSTEM-20261027-001B-E001) and cp_lib.py (COPRIME-CLASS2-20261026-001B-P001) imported read-only
red_team_r0: The on-variety restriction was adopted after E001's off-variety failure; it is the theorem's stated claim (Lemmas 5-6), not a data-driven loosening, and the off-variety failure is kept as control X3 so that the distinction itself is tested.
Sampled vertex states and configurations test the structure at random points, not every point; edge counts are exhaustive over private data.
Locality is tested on one graph shape (a path of two edges); couplings through longer chains or cycles are argued, not measured.
Prediction and measurement share the gadget model; the controls (cumulative design, a missing dual slot, off-variety data) are the discriminators.

Scoping found vanishing vertex pairings on single-edge solutions also for free class 4 on (1, 1) at d = 5, which the clean-edge conditions exclude; the conditions may be conservative, so that algebra is not used as a control.
nonclaims: No claim for the 126 census algebras outside the conditions.
No claim that locality holds off the joint solution variety (E001 and X3 show it can fail there).
forbidden_inputs: Measured counts as inputs to predictions
E001 or diagnostic outputs as inputs to predictions
